ITEM 2.

MANAGEMENT’S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS

Overview

The following discussion should be read in conjunction with the condensed consolidated financial statements and notes included elsewhere in this report.

Total revenue for the three months ended March 31, 2024 was $1,250 million, an increase of 12% compared with $1,116 million in the same period of the prior year, driven by subscription growth across our product families and stronger renewal rates among enterprise customers.

Demand from enterprise customers remained healthy during the quarter, although we observed lengthening sales cycles in certain regions as customers scrutinized technology budgets more carefully than in prior periods and deferred some purchasing decisions

into the following quarter, particularly for larger multi-year agreements that require additional executive approvals.

Operating margin was 31%, compared with 28% a year earlier, reflecting operating leverage on personnel costs, lower facilities expenses following our real estate consolidation, and continued discipline in discretionary spending across all departments.

Liquidity and capital resources. As of March 31, 2024, we had cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments of $4,100 million. We believe that existing cash and cash generated from operations will be sufficient to meet our working capital and capital expenditure requirements for at least the next twelve months.

Accounts receivable increased to $900 million, and days sales outstanding increased modestly because a larger share of billings occurred late in the quarter; we continue to monitor collectibility and the allowance for credit losses closely.

We have a revolving credit facility of $1,000 million, under which no borrowings were outstanding at quarter end, and we were in compliance with all covenants contained in the credit agreement governing that facility.

Critical accounting estimates. There have been no material changes to our critical accounting estimates as described in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023, which you should read together with this discussion for a complete understanding of our judgments.

For a discussion of market risk, see Item 3, Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk, and for risks that could affect our results see Item 2, Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations, and Part II, Item 1A of this report.
